versions.changelog:
- Initial release of text-humanization skill.
- Transforms robotic AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding language by replacing 20+ common phrases.
- Pattern-based JavaScript function for single strings and batch processing of files.
- Pay-per-use API endpoint for automated humanization.
- Customization options for additional domain-specific phrases.
- Promotes greater engagement and trust by removing common AI and corporate phrasing.
